hub.title: Building Data Editing Tools
hub.welcome_title: 🎉 Ready to go — what to do first
hub.welcome_body: In the "Tools" section below, first press the green "Launch" button of the Attribute Editor. The editing screen for viewing and fixing buildings opens in a new tab. You can leave this dashboard tab open.

hub.feedback_details_summary: Desired behavior, target building, environment, etc. (optional)
hub.feedback_label_expected: What would make it easier to use?

review.feedback_placeholder: Enter what you would like the proposer to check
review.feedback_demo_note: In demo mode nothing is sent to the PR.
review.feedback_note: This is recorded as a review comment on the proposal's PR.
review.feedback_confirm_demo: This sends a demo review comment. The actual PR is not modified.
review.feedback_confirm: This is sent to the proposer; you then wait for a reply or a fix.
review.feedback_sent_demo: Sent as a demo (the PR was not modified)
review.feedback_sent: Sent to the proposer. Review again after their reply or fix.

review.feedback_toast: Sent the review comment to the proposer
review.change_hint: Review only what is inside the red frame. Red is the current value; green is the value after approval.
review.reason_missing: No reason for the change was given. CI has sent a review comment.
review.no_blockers: ✅ The change scope and automated checks are fine. Approve once you judge the content to be correct.
review.awaiting_proposer_ci: CI found issues to address. No action is needed from the reviewer.
review.approve_confirm_demo: This shows a demo approval seal. The real data and change history are not modified.
review.approve_confirm: This records your approval in the building's change history.
review.approve_done: Your approval was recorded in the building's change history
review.confirm_label: I have checked the changes, the supporting documents, and the automated check results

hub.check_texture: Facade image and building surface consistency check
hub.check_analyze: Change scope and data format check
hub.retry_update_label: Merge in the latest version and resubmit
hub.retry_update_reason: Another change was applied first, so re-running the checks on the same content will not resolve this
hub.retry_fix_label: Fix the content and the checks re-run automatically
hub.retry_fix_reason: There are items to confirm in the data or the description. Sending a fix re-runs the checks automatically
hub.retry_system_reason: No content issues were found; this may be a temporary failure of the check process
hub.retry_pending_reason: Please wait until the checks finish
hub.cp_wait_proposer_ci: CI has posted items to confirm. Waiting for the proposer to respond
hub.cp_wait_proposer_reviewer: The reviewer has sent a comment to confirm. Waiting for the proposer to respond
hub.cp_pending_action: Automated checks handle this until completion. No reviewer action is needed
hub.cp_reason_ok: The reason for the change and the evidence can be confirmed
hub.cp_reason_ng: The reason for the change or the evidence is not filled in
hub.cp_commit_scope_ok: The change is contained to one building
hub.cp_commit_scope_ng: The change touches multiple buildings, or the building IDs are inconsistent
hub.cp_freshness_ok: The change is based on the latest published data
hub.cp_freshness_ng: Another change was applied first, so the latest version needs to be merged in
hub.cp_file_scope_ok: Only the target building data is changed
hub.cp_file_scope_ng: Files other than building data are included
hub.cp_schema_ok: The file conforms to the CityGML syntax and schema
hub.cp_schema_ng: There is an inconsistency in the CityGML syntax or schema
hub.cp_minimal_diff_ok: There is no large diff unnecessary for review
hub.cp_minimal_diff_ng: The change is large, or unnecessary ID changes are suspected
hub.cp_texture_ok: The facade image references and update method are fine
hub.cp_texture_ng: There is a problem with the facade image references or update method
hub.cp_structure_ok: The surface and ring structures are fine
hub.cp_structure_ng: There is an inconsistency in the surface or ring structures
hub.cp_plausibility_ok: The attribute values and code values are fine
hub.cp_plausibility_ng: There are attribute or code values that need fixing
hub.cp_topology_ok: The change introduces no new topological inconsistencies
hub.cp_topology_ng: The change introduces new topological inconsistencies
hub.cp_model_ok: The building's 3D model can be viewed
hub.cp_model_ng: The building's 3D model cannot be prepared

hub.setup_noclient_lead: This tool's GitHub connection settings are not configured yet. Please contact the distributor.
hub.setup_noclient_diy_body: Place preset.json next to the launcher file (in the Program folder) and write {"oauthClientId": "…"}. On a machine already signed in with the GitHub CLI (gh), you can continue as is.
hub.setup_device_title: Connect to GitHub in another tab
hub.setup_device_lead: First check the number below. Pressing the next button opens a new GitHub tab.
hub.setup_device_step1: Enter the number on GitHub and press Continue.
hub.setup_device_step3: When finished, close the GitHub tab. Return to the "← Return here" tab on the left.
hub.setup_device_return: This screen is where you return. When you finish on GitHub, it advances automatically.
hub.setup_btn_open_github: Copy the number and open GitHub
hub.setup_connect_lead: To fix and propose building data, you need a GitHub account. Pressing the button below first shows an 8-digit number. Read the next screen, then open GitHub in another tab.
hub.setup_connect_note: If you do not have an account, you can create one for free from the page that opens (just an email address and a password). After finishing on GitHub, return to this "Initial setup" tab.
hub.setup_connect_scope: What you will authorize: this tool asks GitHub for the public_repo permission — read and write access to the public repositories of your account. It is used only to create your own copy of the city data, upload your edits, and open change proposals (pull requests); private repositories are not covered. The connection key is stored only on this computer (in a file readable by your account alone) and you can revoke it anytime under GitHub → Settings → Applications.
hub.setup_reused_notice:
Your previous GitHub connection was carried over.
The connection is saved on this computer, so the 8-digit code screen was skipped and setup advanced to here automatically. This is not a malfunction or a mistake.
hub.setup_auth_notice:
The GitHub connection is complete.
An email with the subject "[GitHub] A third-party OAuth application has been added to your account" is a normal notification of this connection. It is unrelated to any Mac prompt; no reply or action inside the email is needed.
hub.setup_fork_lead:
The source data stays as is; your own working copy is created on GitHub. You will use it later when proposing "I fixed this".
Just press the button (usually a few seconds, up to about a minute).
hub.setup_fork_error:
Could not create the copy.
{error}
Check your internet connection and try again with the button below.
hub.setup_git_missing_title: A component needed for the import was not found
hub.setup_git_missing_lead: Close the browser and the terminal for now, check the guide in "READ-ME-FIRST.html" on installing the component, and then open the same launcher file again.
hub.setup_git_missing_win: If this screen appears on the Windows edition, the distributed files are incomplete; please contact the distributor.
hub.setup_git_missing_hint: After preparing, setup resumes where you left off
hub.setup_cloning_lead: The building data is large, so this takes minutes to tens of minutes. Please keep this screen open and wait.
hub.setup_cloning_note: The progress text may not change for several minutes. This is not abnormal. Keep your internet connection and wait without closing this screen or the terminal.
hub.setup_cloning_hint: When it finishes, this advances to "Ready to go"
hub.setup_clone_title: Import the data to this computer
hub.setup_clone_lead_head: Your working copy on GitHub was confirmed ({fork}).
hub.setup_clone_lead_retry: The previous attempt stopped partway. Next time, the tool automatically uses an empty save location.
hub.setup_clone_lead_first: Finally, the data is imported to this computer. The save location is decided automatically, so there is no need to change it.
hub.setup_clone_takes: It takes minutes to tens of minutes.
hub.setup_clone_error:
The previous import could not be completed.
{error}
The partial data is kept, not deleted, and the import safely restarts in an empty location.
hub.setup_clone_keep_open: While importing, keep your internet connection and do not close the browser or the terminal.
hub.setup_btn_clone_retry: Import again to an empty location
hub.setup_done_lead: Well done. Your working copy and the building data import are complete.
hub.setup_done_next:
On the next screen, first press "Launch" on the Attribute Editor.
The editing screen opens in a new tab. The Texture Editor is for fixing facade photos of buildings.
hub.setup_done_reuse: From next time, just open the same launcher file to use the tools without this preparation.
hub.setup_return_tab_title: ← Return here — Building Data Editing Tools
hub.setup_doc_title: Initial setup — Building Data Editing Tools
hub.setup_conn_lost: The connection to the tool was lost. Open the same launcher file again.
hub.setup_poll_error: Checking the status is temporarily delayed. Check your internet connection and wait on this screen.
hub.setup_checking_lead: Please wait without closing the screen. It checks again automatically.
hub.setup_noaccess_title: The source data cannot be reached
hub.setup_noaccess_lead: The GitHub connection is done, but the data repository {url} could not be reached. It may not be published yet, or the network may be down. Contact the data maintainer, or try again later.
hub.err_upstream_unreachable: The source data repository was not found on GitHub. It may not be published yet — contact the data maintainer
